description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectTaskQuickCreate class, which extends the QuickCreate class to implement a quick creation form for project tasks within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes process logic for rendering the form, handling AJAX interactions, and setting up popup data for parent project selection.

classes.name: ProjectTaskQuickCreate
classes.description: Defines the quick create interface for project task records, enabling AJAX and popup interactions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the setup and rendering of the quick create form, including AJAX support and parent popup configuration.
